title: Ignominy
summary: IG'NOMINY, noun [Latin ignominia; in and nomen, against name or reputation.] Public disgrace; shame; reproach; dishonor; infamy. Their generals have been received with honor after their defeat; yours

inlines.v: IG'NOMINY, noun [Latin ignominia; in and nomen, against name or reputation.] Public disgrace; shame; reproach; dishonor; infamy. Their generals have been received with honor after their defeat; yours with ignominy after conquest. Vice begins in mistake, and ends in ignominy
